No. 2438/28 - WEDNESDAY, MAY 28, 2025
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My No.: GAL/LAN/ACQUIS/A13/37.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, that the government intends to acquire the following land for a public purpose.

Description of land/servitude proposed to be obtained : Allotment in extent 2.3806 Hectares described in the schedule below depicted in Cadastral Map No. 610049 in the plan and dated 11.03.2025 prepared by Surveyor General situated in the Villages of Malwana and Jayamalpura in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 61B, Pothukoladeniya in Divisional Secretary’s Division Galigamuwa in Kegalle District in Sabaragamuwa Province :
Schedule 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Pindeniya Estate (Upper Part); Claimants: (01). Managing Director, Kegalle Plantations PLC, No. 310, High Level Road, Navinna, Maharagama.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
(02). Chairman, Land Reform Commission, No. 745, Kaduwela Road, Battaramulla; Extent: 2.3806 Hectares.

On the North by : Jayamalpura (An allotment); On the East by : Jayamalpura (An allotment); On the South by : Jayamalpura (An allotment); On the west by: Road of Lot No. 33 in Lot No. 2 and Jayamalpura (An allotment)

All persons interested in the aforesaid Land/servitude are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Ruwanwella on 23.06.2025 at 10.00 a.m.

Further, it is hereby notified me in writing (in duplicated) before 23.06.2025 regarding the nature of their interests in the land particulars of their claims for compensation for acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount.
H. M. C. Susantha Herath, Divisional Secretary, Galigamuwa. At Divisional Secretariat, Galigamuwa, 22nd May, 2025. EOG 05 - 0197

AMENDMENT
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7

My Ref. No.: KOT/LND/ACQVI/01/08. Land Min. Ref. No. : LD/05/2004/FR/65. IT is hereby notified that in the advertisement published by me in the Gazette Extraordinary of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka No. 2006/11 dated 13.02.2017 under the above heading, that extent of the land to be acquired is 671.6299 Hectares, and that out of the land parts to be acquired, Lot Nos. 1472, 1474, 1475, 1476, 1477 and 1480 are removed from the list of lots of land to be acquired, as they are not relevant for acquisition.
Damsara Karunajeewa Landage, Divisional Secretary, Kotapola. At Divisional Secretariat Kotapola, 22nd May, 2025. EOG 05 - 0198
